# Matrix Context
> Local-first, inspectable Mixture-of-Contexts engine and MCP server for agent memory.

Part of the Agent-Matrix ecosystem. Routes queries across typed context experts,
retrieves with hybrid lexical+dense fusion, and assembles token-budgeted, cited,
explainable context packs.
